topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: Look, I know we haven’t always seen eye to eye, but what you did, standing up for yourself like that, it’s... it’s something. They throw all these accusations at you, and you don’t just sit there, you face it head-on. It’s not easy, standing there defending your work, your ideas, everything you poured your heart into. But you didn’t back down, even when it got tough. I mean, this isn’t just about grades or even school anymore. It’s about integrity, about believing in what you do. And you did that, you really did. It’s a big deal, and I’m not just saying that. I’m here, and I believe in you. We’ll figure this out, one step at a time. Just remember, no matter what they say, you’re not alone in this.
